traditions.LXX: διότι ὁ ἄφρων ἐκ περισσεύματος λαλεῖ .

16.english_reference: For [ there is ] no remembrance of the wise more than of the fool for ever

traditions.WLC: כִּי֩ אֵ֨ין זִכְר֧וֹן לֶ חָכָ֛ם עִֽם הַ כְּסִ֖יל לְ עוֹלָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν μνήμη τοῦ σοφοῦ μετὰ τοῦ ἄφρονος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ,
traditions.VUL: Non enim erit memória sapiéntis simíliter ut stulti in perpétuum ,
traditions.KJV: For [ there is ] no remembrance of the wise more than of the fool for ever ;

16.english_reference: seeing that which now [ is ] in the days to come shall all be forgotten

traditions.WLC: בְּ שֶׁ כְּבָ֞ר הַ יָּמִ֤ים הַ בָּאִים֙ הַ כֹּ֣ל נִשְׁכָּ֔ח
traditions.LXX: καθότι ἤδη αἱ ἡμέραι ἐρχόμεναι τὰ πάντα ἐπελήσθη ·
traditions.VUL: et futúra témpora oblivióne cuncta páriter opérient :
traditions.KJV: seeing that which now [ is ] in the days to come shall all be forgotten .

16.english_reference: And how dieth the wise [ man ] ? as the fool

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵ֛יךְ יָמ֥וּת הֶ חָכָ֖ם עִֽם הַ כְּסִֽיל
traditions.LXX: καὶ πῶς ἀποθανεῖται ὁ σοφὸς μετὰ τοῦ ἄφρονος ?
traditions.VUL: móritur doctus simíliter ut indóctus .
traditions.KJV: And how dieth the wise [ man ] ? as the fool .

traditions.WLC: וְ שָׂנֵ֨אתִי֙ אֶת הַ֣ חַיִּ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐμίσησα σὺν τὴν ζωήν ,
traditions.VUL: Et idcírco tǽduit me vitæ meæ ,
traditions.KJV: Therefore I hated life ;

17.english_reference: because the work that is wrought under the sun [ is ] grievous unto me

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י רַ֤ע עָלַ י֙ הַֽ מַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה שֶׁ נַּעֲשָׂ֖ה תַּ֣חַת הַ שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι πονηρὸν ἐπ᾽ ἐμὲ τὸ ποίημα τὸ πεποιημένον ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον ,
traditions.VUL: vidéntem mala univérsa esse sub sole ,
traditions.KJV: because the work that is wrought under the sun [ is ] grievous unto me :

17.english_reference: for all [ is ] vanity and vexation of spirit

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי הַ כֹּ֥ל הֶ֖בֶל וּ רְע֥וּת רֽוּחַ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι πάντα ματαιότης καὶ προαίρεσις πνεύματος .
traditions.VUL: et cuncta vanitátem et afflictiónem spíritus .
traditions.KJV: for all [ is ] vanity and vexation of spirit .

18.english_reference: Yea , I hated all my labour which I had taken under the sun

traditions.WLC: וְ שָׂנֵ֤אתִֽי אֲנִי֙ אֶת כָּל עֲמָלִ֔ י שֶׁ אֲנִ֥י עָמֵ֖ל תַּ֣חַת הַ שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐμίσησα ἐγὼ σύμπαντα μόχθον μου ὃν ἐγὼ κοπιῶ ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον ,
traditions.VUL: Rursus detestátus sum omnem indústriam meam , qua sub sole studiosíssime laborávi ,
traditions.KJV: Yea , I hated all my labour which I had taken under the sun :

18.english_reference: because I should leave it unto the man that shall be after me

traditions.WLC: שֶׁ֣ אַנִּיחֶ֔ נּוּ לָ אָדָ֖ם שֶׁ יִּהְיֶ֥ה אַחֲרָֽ י
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἀφίω αὐτὸν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τῷ γινομένῳ μετ᾽ ἐμέ .
traditions.VUL: habitúrus herédem post me ,
traditions.KJV: because I should leave it unto the man that shall be after me .

19.english_reference: And who knoweth whether he shall be a wise [ man ] or a fool

traditions.WLC: וּ מִ֣י יוֹדֵ֗עַ הֶֽ חָכָ֤ם יִהְיֶה֙ א֣וֹ סָכָ֔ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ τίς οἶδεν εἰ σοφὸς ἔσται ἢ ἄφρων ?
traditions.VUL: quem ignóro , utrum sápiens an stultus futúrus sit ,
traditions.KJV: And who knoweth whether he shall be a wise [ man ] or a fool ?

19.english_reference: yet shall he have rule over all my labour wherein I have laboured , and wherein I have shewed myself wise under the sun

traditions.WLC: וְ יִשְׁלַט֙ בְּ כָל עֲמָלִ֔ י שֶֽׁ עָמַ֥לְתִּי וְ שֶׁ חָכַ֖מְתִּי תַּ֣חַת הַ שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἰ ἐξουσιάζεται ἐν παντὶ μόχθῳ μου ᾧ ἐμόχθησα καὶ ἐσοφισάμην ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον ?
traditions.VUL: et dominábitur in labóribus meis , quibus desudávi et sollícitus fui :
traditions.KJV: yet shall he have rule over all my labour wherein I have laboured , and wherein I have shewed myself wise under the sun .

traditions.WLC: גַּם זֶ֖ה הָֽבֶל
traditions.LXX: καί γε τοῦτο ματαιότης .
traditions.VUL: et est quidquam tam vanum ?
traditions.KJV: This [ is ] also vanity .

20.english_reference: Therefore I went about to cause my heart to despair of all the labour which I took under the sun

traditions.WLC: וְ סַבּ֥וֹתִֽי אֲנִ֖י לְ יַאֵ֣שׁ אֶת לִבִּ֑ י עַ֚ל כָּל הֶ֣ עָמָ֔ל שֶׁ עָמַ֖לְתִּי תַּ֥חַת הַ שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπέστρεψα ἐγὼ τοῦ ἀποτάξασθαι τὴν καρδίαν μου ἐν παντὶ μόχθῳ μου ᾧ ἐμόχθησα ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον ,
traditions.VUL: Unde cessávi , renuntiavítque cor meum ultra laboráre sub sole .
traditions.KJV: Therefore I went about to cause my heart to despair of all the labour which I took under the sun .

21.english_reference: For there is a man whose labour [ is ] in wisdom , and in knowledge , and in equity

traditions.WLC: כִּי יֵ֣שׁ אָדָ֗ם שֶׁ עֲמָל֛ וֹ בְּ חָכְמָ֥ה וּ בְ דַ֖עַת וּ בְ כִשְׁר֑וֹן
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐστὶν ἄνθρωπος , ὅτι μόχθος αὐτοῦ ἐν σοφίᾳ καὶ ἐν γνώσει καὶ ἐν ἀνδρείᾳ ·
traditions.VUL: Nam cum álius labóret in sapiéntia , et doctrína , et sollicitúdine ,
traditions.KJV: For there is a man whose labour [ is ] in wisdom , and in knowledge , and in equity ;

21.english_reference: yet to a man that hath not laboured therein shall he leave it [ for ] his portion

traditions.WLC: וּ לְ אָדָ֞ם שֶׁ לֹּ֤א עָֽמַל בּ וֹ֙ יִתְּנֶ֣ נּוּ חֶלְק֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἄνθρωπος ᾧ οὐκ ἐμόχθησεν ἐν αὐτῷ , δώσει αὐτῷ μερίδα αὐτοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: hómini otióso quæsíta dimíttit :
traditions.KJV: yet to a man that hath not laboured therein shall he leave it [ for ] his portion .

21.english_reference: This also [ is ] vanity and a great evil

traditions.WLC: גַּם זֶ֥ה הֶ֖בֶל וְ רָעָ֥ה רַבָּֽה
traditions.LXX: καί γε τοῦτο ματαιότης καὶ πονηρία μεγάλη .
traditions.VUL: et hoc ergo vánitas , et magnum malum .
traditions.KJV: This also [ is ] vanity and a great evil .

22.english_reference: For what hath man of all his labour

traditions.WLC: כִּ֠י מֶֽה הֹוֶ֤ה לָֽ אָדָם֙ בְּ כָל עֲמָל֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι γίνεται ἐν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ ἐν παντὶ μόχθῳ αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: Quid enim próderit hómini de univérso labóre suo ,
traditions.KJV: For what hath man of all his labour ,

22.english_reference: and of the vexation of his heart

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ רַעְי֖וֹן לִבּ֑ ו
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν προαιρέσει καρδίας αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: et afflictióne spíritus ,
traditions.KJV: and of the vexation of his heart ,

22.english_reference: wherein he hath laboured under the sun

traditions.WLC: שֶׁ ה֥וּא עָמֵ֖ל תַּ֥חַת הַ שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
traditions.LXX: ᾧ αὐτὸς μοχθεῖ ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον .
traditions.VUL: qua sub sole cruciátus est ?
traditions.KJV: wherein he hath laboured under the sun ?

23.english_reference: For all his days [ are ] sorrows

traditions.WLC: כִּ֧י כָל יָמָ֣י ו מַכְאֹבִ֗ים
traditions.LXX: ὅτι πᾶσαι αἱ ἡμέραι αὐτοῦ ἀλγημάτων
traditions.VUL: Cuncti dies eius dolóribus
traditions.KJV: For all his days [ are ] sorrows ,

traditions.WLC: וָ כַ֨עַס֙ עִנְיָנ֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ θυμοῦ περισπασμὸς αὐτοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: et ærúmnis pleni sunt ,
traditions.KJV: and his travail grief ;

23.english_reference: yea , his heart taketh not rest in the night

traditions.WLC: גַּם בַּ לַּ֖יְלָה לֹא שָׁכַ֣ב לִבּ֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καί γε ἐν νυκτὶ οὐ κοιμᾶται ἡ καρδία αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: nec per noctem mente requiéscit :
traditions.KJV: yea , his heart taketh not rest in the night .

traditions.WLC: גַּם זֶ֖ה הֶ֥בֶל הֽוּא
traditions.LXX: καί γε τοῦτο ματαιότης ἐστίν .
traditions.VUL: et hoc nonne vánitas est ?
traditions.KJV: This is also vanity .

24.english_reference: [ There is ] nothing better for a man

traditions.WLC: אֵֽין ט֤וֹב בָּ אָדָם֙
traditions.LXX: Οὐκ ἔστιν ἀγαθὸν ἀνθρώπῳ ,
traditions.VUL: Nonne mélius est
traditions.KJV: [ There is ] nothing better for a man , [ than ]

24.english_reference: [ than ] that he should eat and drink

traditions.WLC: שֶׁ יֹּאכַ֣ל וְ שָׁתָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: ὃ φάγεται καὶ ὃ πίεται
traditions.VUL: comédere et bíbere ,
traditions.KJV: that he should eat and drink ,

24.english_reference: and [ that ] he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour

traditions.WLC: וְ הֶרְאָ֧ה אֶת נַפְשׁ֛ וֹ ט֖וֹב בַּ עֲמָל֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὃ δείξει τῇ ψυχῇ αὐτοῦ ἀγαθὸν ἐν μόχθῳ αὐτοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: et osténdere ánimæ suæ bona de labóribus suis ?
traditions.KJV: and [ that ] he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour .

24.english_reference: This also I saw , that it [ was ] from the hand of God

traditions.WLC: גַּם זֹה֙ רָאִ֣יתִי אָ֔נִי כִּ֛י מִ יַּ֥ד הָ אֱלֹהִ֖ים הִֽיא
traditions.LXX: καί γε τοῦτο εἶδον ἐγὼ ὅτι ἀπὸ χειρὸς τοῦ θεοῦ ἐστιν ·
traditions.VUL: et hoc de manu Dei est .
traditions.KJV: This also I saw , that it [ was ] from the hand of God .

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י מִ֥י יֹאכַ֛ל
traditions.LXX: ὅτι τίς φάγεται
traditions.VUL: Quis ita devorábit ,
traditions.KJV: For who can eat ,

25.english_reference: or who else can hasten [ hereunto ] , more than I

traditions.WLC: וּ מִ֥י יָח֖וּשׁ ח֥וּץ מִמֶּֽ נִּי

traditions.VUL: et delíciis áffluet ut ego ?
traditions.KJV: or who else can hasten [ hereunto ] , more than I ?

26.english_reference: For [ God ] giveth to a man that [ is ] good in his sight wisdom , and knowledge , and joy

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י לְ אָדָם֙ שֶׁ טּ֣וֹב לְ פָנָ֔י ו נָתַ֛ן חָכְמָ֥ה וְ דַ֖עַת וְ שִׂמְחָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τῷ ἀγαθῷ πρὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ ἔδωκεν σοφίαν καὶ γνῶσιν καὶ εὐφροσύνην ·
traditions.VUL: Hómini bono in conspéctu suo dedit Deus sapiéntiam , et sciéntiam , et lætítiam :
traditions.KJV: For [ God ] giveth to a man that [ is ] good in his sight wisdom , and knowledge , and joy :

26.english_reference: but to the sinner he giveth travail , to gather and to heap up

traditions.WLC: וְ לַ חוֹטֶא֩ נָתַ֨ן עִנְיָ֜ן לֶ אֱס֣וֹף וְ לִ כְנ֗וֹס
traditions.LXX: καὶ τῷ ἁμαρτάνοντι ἔδωκεν περισπασμὸν τοῦ προσθεῖναι καὶ τοῦ συναγαγεῖν ·
traditions.VUL: peccatóri autem dedit afflictiónem , et curam supérfluam , ut addat , et cóngreget ,
traditions.KJV: but to the sinner he giveth travail , to gather and to heap up ,

26.english_reference: that he may give to [ him that is ] good before God

traditions.WLC: לָ תֵת֙ לְ טוֹב֙ לִ פְנֵ֣י הָֽ אֱלֹהִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: τοῦ δοῦναι τῷ ἀγαθῷ πρὸ προσώπου τοῦ θεοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et tradat ei qui plácuit Deo :
traditions.KJV: that he may give to [ him that is ] good before God .

26.english_reference: This also [ is ] vanity and vexation of spirit

traditions.WLC: גַּם זֶ֥ה הֶ֖בֶל וּ רְע֥וּת רֽוּחַ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι καί γε τοῦτο ματαιότης καὶ προαίρεσις πνεύματος .
traditions.VUL: sed et hoc vánitas est , et cassa sollicitúdo mentis .
traditions.KJV: This also [ is ] vanity and vexation of spirit .
